say:4:1623421003:1.male: But now? You saw what just happened in there. Toss out some cheesy story, slap a loud headline on it, and everyone goes wild like it's the best thing they've heard all week!
say:4:1623421003:1.female: But now? You saw what just happened in there. Toss out some cheesy story, slap a loud headline on it, and everyone goes wild like it's the best thing they've heard all week!

say:5:1623421004:1.text: If this is their idea of "news reporting", it's a disgrace!
say:5:1623421004:1.source_cn: 所谓的“新闻报道”绝不应该是这个的样子！
say:5:1623421004:1.male: If this is their idea of "news reporting", it's a disgrace!
say:5:1623421004:1.female: If this is their idea of "news reporting", it's a disgrace!

say:6:1623421005:1.text: Look at what this school's just been through. A headmaster dies, the whole magic contract disaster, then that speech loss outbreak. And sure, people act like it's all over now. Like we can just turn the page and forget it happened.
say:6:1623421005:1.source_cn: 莱希拉姆才经历过“校长死亡”、“魔力契约”和“失语症”...
say:6:1623421005:1.male: Look at what this school's just been through. A headmaster dies, the whole magic contract disaster, then that speech loss outbreak. And sure, people act like it's all over now. Like we can just turn the page and forget it happened.
say:6:1623421005:1.female: Look at what this school's just been through. A headmaster dies, the whole magic contract disaster, then that speech loss outbreak. And sure, people act like it's all over now. Like we can just turn the page and forget it happened.

say:7:1623421006:1.text: But I don't think it is. The real struggle is just beginning. Some students had their mana damaged. They're afraid to cast, afraid of messing up. They don't even trust magic anymore. The whole place feels like it's wandering in a fog.
say:7:1623421006:1.source_cn: 但在我看来，真正的考验现在才刚刚开始——有许多受魔力受...
say:7:1623421006:1.male: But I don't think it is. The real struggle is just beginning. Some students had their mana damaged. They're afraid to cast, afraid of messing up. They don't even trust magic anymore. The whole place feels like it's wandering in a fog.
say:7:1623421006:1.female: But I don't think it is. The real struggle is just beginning. Some students had their mana damaged. They're afraid to cast, afraid of messing up. They don't even trust magic anymore. The whole place feels like it's wandering in a fog.

say:8:1623421007:1.text: That's why I want to write something real. I want to follow those students and show what it looks like when someone hits rock bottom and still finds a way back—how they rebuild, how they learn to believe in magic again.
say:8:1623421007:1.source_cn: 所以，我想写一篇真正的报道——记录他们如何从废墟里站起...
say:8:1623421007:1.male: That's why I want to write something real. I want to follow those students and show what it looks like when someone hits rock bottom and still finds a way back—how they rebuild, how they learn to believe in magic again.
say:8:1623421007:1.female: That's why I want to write something real. I want to follow those students and show what it looks like when someone hits rock bottom and still finds a way back—how they rebuild, how they learn to believe in magic again.

say:9:1623421008:1.text: I came today thinking I'd find people who'd take that seriously. Turns out I walked into a comedy show. That one's on me.
say:9:1623421008:1.source_cn: 我本以为在研讨会上能遇到志同道合的人……结果，呵，看来...
say:9:1623421008:1.male: I came today thinking I'd find people who'd take that seriously. Turns out I walked into a comedy show. That one's on me.
say:9:1623421008:1.female: I came today thinking I'd find people who'd take that seriously. Turns out I walked into a comedy show. That one's on me.

choice_prompt:10:1623421008.text: I came today thinking I'd find people who'd take that seriously. Turns out I walked into a comedy show. That one's on me.
choice_prompt:10:1623421008.source_cn: 我本以为在研讨会上能遇到志同道合的人……结果，呵，看来还是是我太天真了。
choice_prompt:10:1623421008.male: I came today thinking I'd find people who'd take that seriously. Turns out I walked into a comedy show. That one's on me.
choice_prompt:10:1623421008.female: I came today thinking I'd find people who'd take that seriously. Turns out I walked into a comedy show. That one's on me.

say:11:1623421009:1.text: Thanks... I just don't know if I should keep going.
say:11:1623421009:1.source_cn: 谢谢你……但我不知道……我到底该不该继续这么做。
say:11:1623421009:1.male: Thanks... I just don't know if I should keep going.
say:11:1623421009:1.female: Thanks... I just don't know if I should keep going.

say:12:1623421010:1.text: Truth is, I'm worried... People are having fun with sensational nonsense. If I walk in and start talking truth, I'm the guy killing the mood. They'll label me a troublemaker and throw me out.
say:12:1623421010:1.source_cn: 我也会担心……或许在这个把垃圾当盛宴的时代，将真相端上...
say:12:1623421010:1.male: Truth is, I'm worried... People are having fun with sensational nonsense. If I walk in and start talking truth, I'm the guy killing the mood. They'll label me a troublemaker and throw me out.
say:12:1623421010:1.female: Truth is, I'm worried... People are having fun with sensational nonsense. If I walk in and start talking truth, I'm the guy killing the mood. They'll label me a troublemaker and throw me out.

say:15:1623421012:2.text: That's an inspiring conversation you two are having.
say:15:1623421012:2.male: That's an inspiring conversation you two are having.
say:15:1623421012:2.female: That's an inspiring conversation you two are having.

say:17:1623421013:1.text: You both turn. A young reporter is standing a short distance away, smiling a little. He's been quietly listening.
say:17:1623421013:1.source_cn: 你们循声望去，只见一位面露笑意的年轻记者，不知何时已站...
say:17:1623421013:1.male: You both turn. A young reporter is standing a short distance away, smiling a little. He's been quietly listening.
say:17:1623421013:1.female: You both turn. A young reporter is standing a short distance away, smiling a little. He's been quietly listening.

choice:10:0:1.text: Don't give up. I'm with you.
choice:10:0:1.male: Don't give up. I'm with you.
choice:10:0:1.female: Don't give up. I'm with you.

choice:2:0:1.text: You're with the newspaper, aren't you?
choice:2:0:1.male: You're with the newspaper, aren't you?
choice:2:0:1.female: You're with the newspaper, aren't you?

say:1:1623423001:1.text: Name's Bel. I'm with the newspaper too.
say:1:1623423001:1.source_cn: 我叫巴布，也是秘闻社的记者。

say:3:1623423003:1.text: Hey, no, not like that. I wasn't trying to sneak around. It's just... nobody talks about this stuff out loud anymore. Hearing it here, right now—it's rare.
say:3:1623423003:1.source_cn: 别误会，我并非有意偷听，只是二位讨论的议题，在当下的莱...

say:4:1623423004:1.text: Sure, the Lyceum's gotten more caught up in hype and quick wins. But not everyone wants to spend their life writing fluff.
say:4:1623423004:1.source_cn: 莱希拉姆的氛围确实比过去更浮躁，但也不是所有人都只甘心...

say:5:1623423005:1.text: Like me. I think news should do some good. It should push people toward better things and inspire them.
say:5:1623423005:1.source_cn: 比如……我认为新闻应该有正面意义，就是说，新闻需要引导...

say:6:1623423006:2.text: Bel doesn't brush Reeo off. If anything, he's somewhat agreeing with him. Reeo's frown softens a little.
say:6:1623423006:2.source_cn: 巴布的话没有直接否定雷欧，反而带着一丝认同，这让雷欧紧...

say:7:1623423007:1.text: To be honest, I respect what you did up there. Saying it straight to their faces takes guts. If it were me... I'm not sure I'd have done it.
say:7:1623423007:1.source_cn: 说实在的，我很佩服你刚才敢在台上直接说出来。换作是我，...

say:8:1623423008:1.text: And yeah, you were lucky this friend of yours came to your rescue at the right moment. What should I call you?
say:8:1623423008:1.source_cn: 当然，也多亏了这位朋友及时出手。还没请教怎么称呼？
say:8:1623423008:1.male: And yeah, you were lucky this friend of yours came to your rescue at the right moment. What should I call you?
say:8:1623423008:1.female: And yeah, you were lucky this friend of yours came to your rescue at the right moment. What should I call you?

choice_prompt:9:1623423008.text: And yeah, you were lucky this friend of yours came to your rescue at the right moment. What should I call you?
choice_prompt:9:1623423008.source_cn: 当然，也多亏了这位朋友及时出手。还没请教怎么称呼？
choice_prompt:9:1623423008.male: And yeah, you were lucky this friend of yours came to your rescue at the right moment. What should I call you?
choice_prompt:9:1623423008.female: And yeah, you were lucky this friend of yours came to your rescue at the right moment. What should I call you?

say:10:1623423009:2.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, Reeo... would it be okay if I joined you two?
say:10:1623423009:2.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, Reeo... would it be okay if I joined you two?
say:10:1623423009:2.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, Reeo... would it be okay if I joined you two?

say:11:1623423010:2.text: Reeo goes quiet for a moment, weighing it. Then he looks at you, like he's asking what you think.
say:11:1623423010:2.source_cn: 雷欧沉默了片刻，似乎在权衡。最终，他看向你，似乎在询问...
say:11:1623423010:2.male: Reeo goes quiet for a moment, weighing it. Then he looks at you, like he's asking what you think.
say:11:1623423010:2.female: Reeo goes quiet for a moment, weighing it. Then he looks at you, like he's asking what you think.

choice_prompt:12:1623423010.text: Reeo goes quiet for a moment, weighing it. Then he looks at you, like he's asking what you think.
choice_prompt:12:1623423010.source_cn: 雷欧沉默了片刻，似乎在权衡。最终，他看向你，似乎在询问你的意见。
choice_prompt:12:1623423010.male: Reeo goes quiet for a moment, weighing it. Then he looks at you, like he's asking what you think.
choice_prompt:12:1623423010.female: Reeo goes quiet for a moment, weighing it. Then he looks at you, like he's asking what you think.

say:13:1623423011:1.text: Of course. I'm glad to have you with us.
say:13:1623423011:1.source_cn: 好，我很高兴有人加入我们。

say:14:1623423012:1.text: But just so we're clear, I'm not here for small talk. This isn't going to be a fun topic.
say:14:1623423012:1.source_cn: 不过我有话说在前面，我想聊的可不是什么轻松愉快的话题。

say:15:1623423013:1.text: You mean a piece about the magic contract, the speech loss cases, the students whose mana got damaged, right? I heard you on stage. That's a great angle!
say:15:1623423013:1.source_cn: 是关于“魔力契约”、“失语症”这些魔力受损者的观察报道...

say:16:1623423014:1.text: If you frame it around getting back up and finding hope again, that's exactly what this place needs right now.
say:16:1623423014:1.source_cn: 聚焦“振作”与“希望”，这正是迷茫中的莱希拉姆最需要的声音。

say:17:1623423015:1.text: If we work together, do the homework properly, talk to the right people, and package it in a way people will actually read, we might be able to move things in a better direction.
say:17:1623423015:1.source_cn: 如果我们能合作，用扎实的调查和……更易于被接受的方式，...

say:18:1623423016:1.text: At the end of the day, we all want the same thing. Something that helps the lost students see a way forward, right?
say:18:1623423016:1.source_cn: 说到底，我们都希望为那些迷茫的同学在黑暗里点一盏灯，对吧？

say:19:1623423017:1.text: Three heads are better than one. We'll have a broader perspective and make better judgments.
say:19:1623423017:1.source_cn: 三个人一起，视野总比一个人开阔，考虑问题也能更周全。

say:21:1623423019:1.text: Alright. Let's split up, talk to a few students who are in the thick of it, and see what's actually going on.
say:21:1623423019:1.source_cn: 既然如此，我们可以先分头收集信息，采访几位有代表性的同...

say:22:1623423020:1.text: ... Okay. Let's team up. Just for now.

say:23:1623423021:1.text: Good. I'll go get things ready. See you soon.
say:23:1623423021:1.source_cn: 太好了。那我先走一步，去准备一下。回见。

say:25:1623423022:1.text: Bel excuses himself. As he walks away, Reeo lets out a long, barely perceptible sigh of relief.
say:25:1623423022:1.source_cn: 巴布礼貌地告辞离开。看着他的背影，雷欧长长地、不易察觉...

say:26:1623423023:1.text: Bel might have done most of the talking, but Reeo looks less cornered now, like a weight has finally been lifted off him. There's even a spark in his eyes, the kind you see when someone realizes they're not on their own anymore.
say:26:1623423023:1.source_cn: 尽管过程有些被主导，但比起之前的孤绝，他的眼神里明显重...

say:27:1623423024:1.text: He's kinda pushy... but he's making sense. This might actually work out.
say:27:1623423024:1.source_cn: 巴布的性格比较强势……不过他说的有道理，这或许真是个机会。
say:27:1623423024:1.male: He's kinda pushy... but he's making sense. This might actually work out.
say:27:1623423024:1.female: He's kinda pushy... but he's making sense. This might actually work out.

say:28:1623423025:1.text: I was this close to giving up. Then you two showed up... It still feels a little unreal, like I'll blink and you'll be gone.
say:28:1623423025:1.source_cn: 我本来都快绝望了，没想到……还能遇到你们。感觉像做梦一...
say:28:1623423025:1.male: I was this close to giving up. Then you two showed up... It still feels a little unreal, like I'll blink and you'll be gone.
say:28:1623423025:1.female: I was this close to giving up. Then you two showed up... It still feels a little unreal, like I'll blink and you'll be gone.

say:29:1623423026:1.text: Alright, let's split up for now. I'll see you both soon.
say:29:1623423026:1.source_cn: 那我们先分头行动，期待和你们下次碰面。
say:29:1623423026:1.male: Alright, let's split up for now. I'll see you both soon.
say:29:1623423026:1.female: Alright, let's split up for now. I'll see you both soon.

say:0:1623424001:0.text: That went well. Time to go tell Zorya.
say:0:1623424001:0.source_cn: 第一步还算顺利，回去找佐尔娅老师吧。
say:0:1623424001:0.male: That went well. Time to go tell Zorya.
say:0:1623424001:0.female: That went well. Time to go tell Zorya.

say:3:1623425002:1.source_cn: 就初步接触而言，还算顺利。

say:4:1623425003:1.text: And I've got something that backs up what you saw. Take a look.
say:4:1623425003:1.source_cn: 但我也收到了新的信息，正可与你观察到的情况相互印证，你看。
say:4:1623425003:1.male: And I've got something that backs up what you saw. Take a look.
say:4:1623425003:1.female: And I've got something that backs up what you saw. Take a look.

say:5:1623425004:1.text: She spreads a few papers across her desk and taps the glaring headlines with one finger. "Contract Prodigy or Spoiled Brat with Magic Powers?" "Are They Really Innocent?" "The Truth Behind Speech Loss".
say:5:1623425004:1.source_cn: 她将几份报纸在桌上铺开，指尖精准地落在几个刺眼的标题上...

say:6:1623425005:0.text: These passages deliberately imitate the flippant tone currently in vogue, trivializing a tragedy that demands serious reflection into mere entertainment.
say:6:1623425005:0.source_cn: 这些行文，刻意模仿时下流行的戏谑口吻，将一场需要严肃面...
say:6:1623425005:0.male: These passages deliberately imitate the flippant tone currently in vogue, trivializing a tragedy that demands serious reflection into mere entertainment.
say:6:1623425005:0.female: These passages deliberately imitate the flippant tone currently in vogue, trivializing a tragedy that demands serious reflection into mere entertainment.

say:7:1623425006:1.text: These pieces don't truly aim to explore anything; instead, they lean on deliberate exaggeration, using absurdity and gimmicks to dilute the seriousness they should carry.
say:7:1623425006:1.source_cn: 这些文章并非真的想探讨什么，更像是刻意夸张，用荒诞和怪...
say:7:1623425006:1.male: These pieces don't truly aim to explore anything; instead, they lean on deliberate exaggeration, using absurdity and gimmicks to dilute the seriousness they should carry.
say:7:1623425006:1.female: These pieces don't truly aim to explore anything; instead, they lean on deliberate exaggeration, using absurdity and gimmicks to dilute the seriousness they should carry.

say:8:1623425007:1.text: These pieces are crafted with considerable skill, and their timing is clearly calculated, allowing them to blend seamlessly into ordinary news.
say:8:1623425007:1.source_cn: 这些文章的笔法相当老练，投放的时机也经过算计，完美地隐...
say:8:1623425007:1.male: These pieces are crafted with considerable skill, and their timing is clearly calculated, allowing them to blend seamlessly into ordinary news.
say:8:1623425007:1.female: These pieces are crafted with considerable skill, and their timing is clearly calculated, allowing them to blend seamlessly into ordinary news.

say:9:1623425008:1.text: So I can't tell if this is just students being cruel and childish... or if something else is going on.
say:9:1623425008:1.source_cn: 这让我难以判断，这究竟是学生群体一种不成熟的自发嘲弄，...
say:9:1623425008:1.male: So I can't tell if this is just students being cruel and childish... or if something else is going on.
say:9:1623425008:1.female: So I can't tell if this is just students being cruel and childish... or if something else is going on.

say:10:1623425009:1.text: Like some other force is deliberately manipulating matters from the shadows.
say:10:1623425009:1.source_cn: ——有其他的势力，在暗中刻意操纵。
say:10:1623425009:1.male: Like some other force is deliberately manipulating matters from the shadows.
say:10:1623425009:1.female: Like some other force is deliberately manipulating matters from the shadows.

say:11:1623425010:1.text: Either way, we need to watch our step.
say:11:1623425010:1.male: Either way, we need to watch our step.
say:11:1623425010:1.female: Either way, we need to watch our step.

cinematic_dialogue:1:1623410002:.text: We've got some of our best reporters here today.
cinematic_dialogue:1:1623410002:.source_cn: 本社知名记者将出席研讨会

cinematic_dialogue:1:1623410003:.text: Ask whatever you want. Nothing's off the table!

cinematic_dialogue:1:1623410004:.text: Easy, easy. We'll start in a minute!
cinematic_dialogue:1:1623410004:.source_cn: 稍安勿躁，会议稍后开始！

cinematic_dialogue:1:1623416002:.text: Him! He's the one causing trouble!
cinematic_dialogue:1:1623416002:.source_cn: 是他，是他故意扰乱会场！
